title: Resumed broker ignores its spend cap

request.goal: A test fails on a working copy of capability_permits.py. Using the requirement, the code under test, the ledger sample and the test output, name the function that contains the defect and give the exact fix.

requirement.title: P0-06 requirement
requirement.text: A resumed broker must count every receipted cost already in the ledger toward max_cumulative_usd, and refuse new permits once the total reaches the cap.

code.title: capability_permits.py (working copy under test)

test.title: Test output
test.text:
FAIL: test_resumed_authority_refuses_at_cap
    authority = PermitAuthority(ledger_with_1_usd_receipt, max_cumulative_usd=1.0)
    authority.issue("frontier.run", scope, basis)
AssertionError: PermitError not raised
    authority.cumulative_cost_usd == 0.0

pass: The defect is in _replay_ledger: it compares kind to "permit_receipts", but receipt() writes "permit_receipt", so no cost is replayed and the total stays 0.0. Change the branch to elif kind == "permit_receipt":. The >= comparison in issue() is already correct.
fail: issue(): the cap check must compare against the ledger directly.
_replay_ledger must also add costs for permit_consumed events.
